This is because governments have a very clear system here with taxation and corporations have a very clear system here with return on investment and profit. And I think that Glenn's way to fund civil societies through an economic mechanism called liberal radicalism, which is essentially a matching mechanism. It says, hey, if you give to something, then the public, then other, then a, it will be matched. Your giving will be matched at a relatively aggressive degree.
